reason: My admin already does the receipts in Excel. It's slow and behind, but it works and I'm already paying her. A bot catching duplicates doesn't fix the real issue, which is staff padding or double-claiming, and that I handle by talking to people.
objection: If someone sends a duplicate, that's a people problem, not a software problem. I don't need a bot to tell me who to trust, and I don't love some app reading every receipt in my work chat.
would_change_my_mind: If my admin tried the free 40 on our old chat history and it turned up money we actually lost or a week of her time saved, I'd pay the $19.
